summary: Compose the admitted CBR FX adapter, immutable FX repository and Finance surface in the production worker without turning global reference data into a tenant sync account.

impacts.evidence: CBR facts are global public reference data as established by ADR 0065; the worker does not create or infer a tenant connector account.
Currency codes, exact rates, public source references and timestamps contain no tenant data or PII and retain the existing finance backup policy.
The existing authenticated GET /api/v1/fx/rates read contract is unchanged; no path, schema or response meaning changes.
No event schema, topic, producer envelope or consumer behavior changes.
The existing additive FXRateReader interface and cbr-fx manifest are unchanged; only host composition is added.
The worker uses the existing append-only fx_rate_facts and fx_resolution_evidence repository; no table or stored row is rewritten.
Public read-only CBR egress uses the shared HTTPS-only DNS/public-address/pinned-dial/redirect-deny transport; no secret is accepted or logged.
The operation reads public reference data and appends immutable facts; it exposes no tenant or remote write and requires no approval bypass.
Every selected observation is persisted with source reference and deterministic resolution evidence before Finance can consume it.
Stable fact IDs and append-only conflict checks make repeated observations idempotent; the process cache is non-authoritative.
A new fixed official egress destination is admitted through the existing host-owned connector transport; no webhook destination handling changes.
The worker emits bounded success/deferred events and keeps CBR outages isolated from unrelated supervised components.
Rollback is a worker/frontend binary rollback. Already persisted immutable facts remain valid history and require no destructive cleanup.
Tests cover exact registry admission, generated surface classification, full currency dispatch and fail-closed all-source failure; live qualification verifies persistence.
